display.purpose: Readings and top-level screen titles only.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Theme, selection, evidence, and navigation feedback; reduced motion uses an instant change or crossfade.

narrative.overview: The app is an observatory for uncertainty: original tarot art occupies the emotional foreground, while evidence, timing, risk, and simulated portfolio state remain legible underneath. Interaction remains familiar on each operating system.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained lilac and aubergine surfaces with rare candle-gold emphasis.
Editorial serif display moments paired with platform-native sans-serif controls.
Evidence and Demo state visible in the same flow as the mystical interpretation.

rules.name: The Rare Gold Rule
rules.body: Candle gold defines ritual structure; if it becomes the default text or button color, it has lost its meaning.

rules.name: The Split Voice Rule
rules.body: Display serif is forbidden in buttons, evidence data, form labels, transaction values, and navigation.

rules.name: The One Physical Object Rule
rules.body: Never turn every section into a floating card.

dos: Do use the preserved Compass and Rowan assets as visual-fidelity anchors.
Do keep factual observations, timestamp, uncertainty, and Demo status adjacent to every investment idea.
donts: Don't build generic navy-and-green brokerage dashboards with mystical decoration added afterward.
Don't hide market influence, imply supernatural guarantees, or design disclosure language to escape notice.
Don't use romance, urgency, jealousy, exclusivity, or sexual pressure to influence a financial decision.
